name: Nowgaon–Kulpahar District road

tollInfo.note: District roads in India are not tolled.

significance: MDR 17B, Nowgaon–Kulpahar District road, crosses the border between Madhya Pradesh and Uttar Pradesh. A state road that runs through more than one state has no single owner — MP PWD and UP PWD each maintain the stretch inside their own state, so which department to contact depends on where along the road you are.
